title: Translation & Interpretation
intro: Professional English↔Chinese and French↔Chinese translation based in China. We translate documents, provide on‑site interpretation for meetings and factory visits, and localize your content for the Chinese market.

steps.title: Discovery & Scope
steps.description: We clarify languages, subject matter, delivery format, and deadlines (legal, business, technical, academic).

steps.title: Document Intake
steps.description: You share files securely; we assess terminology, layout, and any certification requirements.

steps.title: Translation & Review
steps.description: Native linguists translate and proofread; optional bilingual layout and notarization guidance available.

steps.title: Delivery & Support
steps.description: We deliver polished files and support in‑person or remote interpretation around China as needed.

cta.heading: Need reliable translation in China?
cta.text: Get document translation, interpretation, and localization by trusted experts.
